subject: Emotions
title: Emotional Contagion
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Emotional Contagion.

hook.text: Your colleague enters stressed. Within minutes, your heart rate rises and you feel anxious. You caught his emotion.

buildup.text: Hatfield proved emotions spread via automatic mimicry—you copy others' facial expressions and posture unconsciously.

discovery.text: Mirror neurons fire when you watch someone's action or emotion. Your brain simulates their state to understand it.

twist.text: Contagion works online too. Facebook's 2014 experiment showed that altering feeds changed users' emotional posts.

climax.text: Leaders are especially contagious. A stressed boss creates a stressed team—mood flows downward in hierarchies.

punchline.text: Emotions are contagious. Choose your company like you choose your health.

quiz.question: What mechanism spreads emotions between people?
